examples.text: The lyrics describe how the gang members intend to <w>bun</w> their rivals.

examples.text: Don't care about your crew, <w>bun</w> them any day.

target_lang_translations.fr: Je me fiche de ton équipe, je peux les <w>shooter</w> n'importe quel jour.

target_lang_translations.cs: Nezajímá mě tvoje parta, kdykoliv je <w>odstřelím</w>.
